headline: Jensen Huang steps down at Nvidia; FAA ground stop halts US flights; Europe seeks seat at Ukraine talks

austin.headline: Austin airport scrambles to help travellers during national ground stop
austin.summary: Austin-Bergstrom staff mobilised to assist stranded passengers after the FAA halted flights nationwide.

texas.headline: Mental health now the leading cause of pregnancy-related deaths in Texas
texas.summary: A new state maternal mortality report finds mental health conditions are the top cause of deaths during or after pregnancy.

texas.headline: Paxton drops suit accusing the NCAA of deceptive marketing of women's sports
texas.summary: The attorney general's office ended its lawsuit against the college sports body.

texas.headline: Republican tries to block Democrat's House District 93 win over eligibility
texas.summary: The losing GOP candidate is challenging the result, questioning whether the Democratic winner is eligible to serve.

texas.headline: Transgender Texans express hope after Democratic midterm gains
texas.summary: Members of the state's transgender community reacted to the election results with relief and optimism.

us.headline: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after more than four hours
us.summary: All US flights were halted over an air traffic control communication problem, and cancellations are expected to continue into the weekend.

us.headline: Homeland security chief says flight stoppage was not an attack
us.summary: Secretary Mullin said the FAA halt was not comparable to 9/11.

us.headline: Maker of FAA's SMART AI tool denies role in the ground stop
us.summary: Transportation Secretary Duffy confirmed the company's denial that its system caused the outage.

us.headline: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate Democratic leader
us.summary: The Maryland senator's bid has opened a debate over what mandate Democrats won in the midterms.

us.headline: Turnout trends help explain Southern midterm results
us.summary: NPR examines two voter turnout patterns behind the election outcomes across the South.

australia.headline: AFP commissioner warns of 'terrorism 2.0' threat
australia.summary: The federal police chief cautioned that Australia faces an evolving terrorism threat, during Friday's federal politics coverage.

australia.headline: UN adviser criticises Victorian opposition plan to scrap Treaty
australia.summary: The Coalition's pledge to end Victoria's Treaty process drew criticism from a UN adviser on the campaign trail.

australia.headline: Labor outspending Liberals on online ads before Victorian election
australia.summary: Advertising data shows Labor is spending more than the Liberals on digital political ads.

australia.headline: US flight ground stop disrupts Australian travellers
australia.summary: ABC tracked the FAA's nationwide halt and its lifting after thousands of passengers were affected.

ai.headline: Jensen Huang leaves Nvidia; interim CEO inherits legal and AI risks
ai.summary: Huang has stepped down as Nvidia chief, leaving his interim successor a pending investigation and large AI bets.

ai.headline: Nvidia board says it has not yet hired a search firm for a permanent CEO
ai.summary: Directors told CNBC the hunt for Huang's long-term replacement has not formally begun.

ai.headline: Lutnick reportedly agrees to testify on Nvidia China chip sales
ai.summary: The Commerce Secretary has been drawn into the Nvidia scandal and is reported to have agreed to testify.

ai.headline: Trump will not raise Nvidia spy issue on China trip
ai.summary: The president does not plan to bring up the Huang matter with Chinese officials.

tech.headline: SpaceX launches Starship on key test flight
tech.summary: The company flew its giant rocket in another major test of the system.

tech.headline: Nvidia turmoil drives rotation across chip stocks
tech.summary: Investors moved money toward rivals and suppliers such as AMD, Broadcom and TSMC.

world.headline: Europe to send diplomats to Ukraine peace talks
world.summary: European leaders meeting in Dublin pushed for a voice and agreed to add a team, bringing in Italy and Poland.

world.headline: Ukraine launches nearly 1,200 drones at Russia
world.summary: The large attack came as US-led talks considered broader European security arrangements.

world.headline: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill at least three
world.summary: More than 20 people were also injured in the attacks.

world.headline: UN chief calls for immediate, drastic emissions cuts
world.summary: The secretary-general urged steep reductions to avoid climate catastrophe as COP31 continues.

aus-cricket.headline: Labuschagne spins through Tasmania late on day two at the Gabba
aus-cricket.summary: Marnus Labuschagne's part-time bowling produced late drama for Queensland in gloomy conditions.

aus-cricket.headline: Victoria and WA, NSW and SA play on in Shield round four
aus-cricket.summary: Both Sheffield Shield matches continued on Saturday; live scores are on ABC's score centre.

warriors.headline: Spurs rout Warriors 123-85 in San Antonio
warriors.summary: Golden State, with Stephen Curry sidelined, lost by 38 points on Friday night.

warriors.headline: Curry out at least two weeks with oblique tear
warriors.summary: The Warriors star will miss at least two weeks after scans found a torn oblique muscle.
